command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp
echo "== verify staged input against pinned sha256 (same residues iqtree's alignment holds) =="
echo "3adadccdf1c0af2d2931b7d6dae68355c4df5ac2cff3905cb5c251bf1d78d43f  pfam_unaligned.fa" | sha256sum -c -
echo "== mafft align: FFT-NS-2, single thread (deterministic) =="
mafft --thread 1 --retree 2 --maxiterate 0 pfam_unaligned.fa > mafft_aln.fa 2> mafft.log
echo "== determinism: identical on rerun =="
mafft --thread 1 --retree 2 --maxiterate 0 pfam_unaligned.fa > rerun.fa 2>/dev/null
DET=$(cmp -s mafft_aln.fa rerun.fa && echo YES || echo NO)
rm -f rerun.fa
# ---- smoke check (awk; no python in image). RESIDUE CONSERVATION is the identity:
# an aligner may only insert gaps, never alter/drop residues -- exact, method-independent.
# NOT a column comparison vs muscle (two MSAs differ by design; the mafft<->muscle
# cross-code check is downstream RF=0 via iqtree, in the nf-spawn Shape-F recipe).
lin() { awk '/^>/{if(s)print id"\t"s; id=substr($1,2); s=""; next}{gsub(/\r/,"");s=s$0}END{if(s)print id"\t"s}' "$1" | tr 'a-z' 'A-Z'; }
lin pfam_unaligned.fa > in.tsv
lin mafft_aln.fa       > out.tsv
NIN=$(wc -l < in.tsv | tr -d ' '); NOUT=$(wc -l < out.tsv | tr -d ' ')
NWIDTHS=$(awk -F'\t' '{print length($2)}' out.tsv | sort -u | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
AWID=$(awk -F'\t' '{print length($2); exit}' out.tsv)
MAXIN=$(awk -F'\t' '{if(length($2)>m)m=length($2)}END{print m}' in.tsv)
UNGAP=$(awk -F'\t' '{g=$2; gsub(/-/,"",g); s+=length(g)}END{print s}' out.tsv)
CONS=$(join -t"$(printf '\t')" <(sort in.tsv) <(awk -F'\t' '{g=$2;gsub(/-/,"",g);print $1"\t"g}' out.tsv | sort) | awk -F'\t' '$2==$3{ok++}END{print ok+0}')
{
  echo "aligned_sequences    $NOUT   want 114 (== input)"
  echo "residue_conservation $CONS   want 114 (ungap(row)==input, every sequence)"
  echo "ungapped_total       $UNGAP   want 49098 (residues preserved, none altered/dropped)"
  echo "rectangular          $NWIDTHS distinct row length   want 1"
  echo "aln_width_ge_max_in  width=$AWID max_input=$MAXIN   want width>=max"
  echo "deterministic_rerun  $DET   want YES"
} > smoke-check.txt
cat smoke-check.txt
test "$NIN" -eq 114; test "$NOUT" -eq 114; test "$CONS" -eq 114
test "$UNGAP" -eq 49098; test "$NWIDTHS" -eq 1; test "$AWID" -ge "$MAXIN"; test "$DET" = YES
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
